items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: So we got in the cab and went over to the Astor Hotel across in Times Square and up in the ballroom, he had his group playing there... So we played 'The Saints Come Marching In.'

ctx.x: Passed the word on, second or third hand.
